blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-chain reasoning is a challenging task not only because the multi-chain evidence is dispersed, but also because different parts of reasoning may require distinct, interacting chains of support. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. We introduce RESIN (Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing), which uses structure to locate evidence while keeping the original source as the basis for reasoning. RESIN decomposes a question into focused one-hop needs, retrieves a small set of source-grounded units for each hop, and places only this relevant evidence in a compact reasoning buffer. The buffer preserves alternative supports until final composition, making intermediate decisions explicit without forcing a brittle path. On the full HolisQA benchmark, RESIN achieves 82.92 context recall and 76.70 answer relevancy over all questions, with higher reported CR and AR across five domains and higher F1 in four domains than the published baselines. Ablations show that both typed evidence diversity and hop-wise decomposition are essential, supporting a clear conclusion: Precise evidence organization and delayed commitment make multi-chain reasoning effective and auditable. Our code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN.
blocks.zh: 多链推理是一项具有挑战性的任务,不仅因为多链证据被分散,而且因为推理的不同部分可能需要不同的互动支持链. 平面取回可以将文本松散相通的模型淹没,而早期选择单一推理路径则可以丢弃只有在考虑其他事实后才变得有用的证据. 我们引入RESIN(与实体结构索引重合),它使用结构定位证据,同时保留原始来源作为推理的基础. RESIN将一个问题分解为焦点的一跳需要,为每跳取出一组以源为基础的小单元,并仅将这个相关证据放入紧凑推理缓冲. 缓冲保留了替代支持直到最终组成,在不强迫走一条简陋的道路的情况下作出中间决定。 在完整的HolisQA基准上,RESIN实现了82.92个上下文回顾和76.70个回答对所有问题的关联性,所报告的CR和AR覆盖了五个领域,在四个领域的F1高于已公布的基准. 分解表明,键入式证据多样性和随机分解都至关重要,支持明确的结论: 精确的证据组织和延迟的承诺使多链推理有效和可审计。 我们的代码见https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Resin at a glance. Offline, entity-structured records serve as addresses into source-grounded evidence. Online, a dependency-aware plan creates focused one-hop needs; each retrieves a small candidate set, and the resulting evidence buffer remains available until final composition.
blocks.zh: 图1:一目了然。 离线、实体结构的记录可作为来源证据的地址。 在线上,有依赖意识的计划产生重点的一跳需要;每一次检索一个小的一组候选人,由此产生的证据缓冲器在最终组成之前仍然可用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multi-chain reasoning requires a model to assemble several kinds of evidence chains whose roles are not interchangeable. One kind may identify an entity; another may catch a property or a state transition; and the third may conduct reasoning by following certain rules. The challenge is therefore not simply to find relevant text, but to assign evidence to the right inferential role while preserving entity identity, scope, condition, and direction.
blocks.zh: 多链推理需要一种模型来组装几种不能互换作用的证据链. 一种可能确定一个实体;另一种可能抓住财产或国家过渡;第三种可能遵循某些规则进行推理。 因此,挑战不仅仅是找到相关案文,而是在保留实体身份、范围、条件和方向的同时,将证据分配给正确的推论角色。

blocks.en: Such distinct mechanisms make multi-chain reasoning a rich but challenging task. A passage that share many words with the question may not eventually contribute to the reasoning path, whereas a less obvious passage may later supply the bridge for effective multi-chain reasoning. A system that ranks evidence only against the complete question cannot handle such complexity. Thus a system that commits to the first locally plausible chain risks the opposite error: it may explain one part of the answer while losing a parallel chain needed for another.
blocks.zh: 这种独特的机制使多链推理成为一项丰富而具有挑战性的任务。 与问题有着许多同名词的段落可能最终无助于推理途径,而不太明显的段落则可能为有效的多链推理提供桥梁。 仅仅针对整个问题对证据进行排序的系统不能处理这种复杂问题。 因此,一个承诺第一个当地可能存在的链条的系统有可能出现相反的错误:它可能解释答案的某一部分,同时失去另一部分所需的平行链条。

blocks.en: Existing evidence-access strategies tend to encounter difficulties at handling such complexity. A single broad search compresses all information needs into one query, which can blur their roles, introduce distracting context, and impose the same granularity on every step ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) . Repeated search exposes intermediate information needs ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Asai et al., 2024 ) , but untyped passages still leave entity and state bindings implicit. Graph-based systems make relations explicit ( Edge et al., 2024 ; Jiménez Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , yet extraction and edge ranking are uncertain: pruning to one node, edge, or path can remove correct support before all chains are reconciled. This is especially risky in scientific text, where a relation may change with the condition, population, or state ( Parekh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有证据获取战略在处理这种复杂性方面往往遇到困难。 单宽搜索将所有信息需求压缩成一个查询,可以模糊其角色,引入分心上下文,并给每一步施加相同的颗粒性(刘等,2024;陈等,2024;蒋等,2024). 重复搜索暴露出中间信息需求(Trivedi等,2023;Jiang等,2023;Asai等,2024),但未打字的段落仍会留下实体和状态约束隐含. 基于图表的系统使关系变得明确(Edge等,2024;Jiménez Gutiérrez等,2025;Li等,2025;Guo等,2025;),然而取出和边缘的排名还不确定:在调和所有链条之前,推向一个节点,边缘,或路径可以移除正确的支持. 在科学文本中,这种情况尤其危险,因为在科学文本中,关系可能随条件、人口或状态而改变(Parekh等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: The underlying mismatch is between the object that can be indexed in advance and the object required to answer a particular question. Evidence records should be reusable and query independent, whereas a valid chain is query specific: the same statement may be central for one question, a bridge for another, and irrelevant for a third. Precomputing every possible chain is neither tractable nor robust, because the number of combinations grows quickly and every extracted edge becomes an early commitment. Deferring all organization until generation avoids that early commitment but returns the model to a large, weakly structured context. What is needed is an intermediate representation that is fine grained enough to locate precise evidence, yet flexible enough to assemble different chains on demand.
blocks.zh: 根本的不匹配在于可以事先索引的对象和回答特定问题所需的对象之间. 证据记录应可重复使用和独立查询,而有效的链条则是具体的查询:同一声明可能是一个问题的核心,另一个问题的桥梁,与第三个问题无关。 预先计算出每一个可能的链条既不是可牵引的,也不是坚固的,因为组合的数量会迅速增长,每一个被提取的边缘都会成为早期的承诺. 将所有组织推迟至一代人,避免这种早期承诺,但将模式恢复到结构薄弱的大背景。 所需要的是中间代表,其精细的颗粒足以找到准确的证据,但足够灵活,可按要求组装出不同的链条。

blocks.en: We propose a different division of labor. Structure should tell the system where to look ; whereas source-grounded evidence should tell it what to believe . Resin organizes evidence into typed, provenance-linked units that act as precise addresses. It then builds a small reasoning buffer for the current question rather than exposing the model to the full text or index. The buffer assigns a candidate set to each planned hop and retains alternatives until final composition. Thus, structure improves access without becoming a brittle, prematurely fixed reasoning path.
blocks.zh: 我们提出不同的分工. 结构应该告诉系统在哪里看;而来源证据应该告诉它相信什么。 Resin将证据组织成打出,出处相通的单位,起到精确地址的作用. 然后它为当前问题构建出一个小的推理缓冲器,而不是将模型暴露在全文或索引上. 缓冲器为每个计划中的跳动分配一组候选人,并保留替代品直至最终组成. 因此,结构改善进入,而不会成为一条不成熟、过早固定的推理道路。

blocks.en: Figure 1 makes this separation concrete. The upper half is query independent: source passages are organized around their central entities, converted into compact reasoning units, and linked back to exact evidence. The lower half begins with the question: a planner expresses it as focused one-hop needs, retrieval fills a bounded candidate set for each need, and local answers expose what each set supports. The final composer sees the original question and the complete buffer. Dependency metadata records how the subquestions fit together, while the evidence itself remains available for global reconciliation.
blocks.zh: 图1使这种分离变得具体。 上半部分是查询独立的:源道围绕其中心实体组织,被转换为紧凑推理单位,并链接回确切的证据. 下半部分从问题开始:一个计划员将其表达为焦点一跳需要,检索填补了每个需要设定的受限候选人,本地解答则暴露出每个组合支持的内容. 最终作曲家看到了最初的问题和完整的缓冲. 依赖性元数据记录子问题如何组合在一起,而证据本身仍然可供全球调节使用。

blocks.en: This architecture offers three practical advantages. First, it bounds the model’s working context by the number of planned needs and the per-hop candidate budget, rather than by corpus size. Second, it makes failures inspectable: one can distinguish a missing indexed unit, a retrieval miss, an incorrect local interpretation, and a composition error. Third, it keeps competing evidence recoverable until the system has seen all parts of the question. These properties motivate our central hypothesis: multi-chain reasoning improves when evidence is localized early but selected late. The experiments test both sides of this claim by varying the unit representation, the decomposition strategy, and the number of candidates retained per hop.
blocks.zh: 这种架构提供了三个实际优势. 首先,它把模型的工作环境限定在计划需求的数目和每个候选人的预算上,而不是按实体规模。 第二,它使故障可以检查:人们可以区分缺失的索引单元,检索误差,不正确的本地解释,以及组成错误. 第三,在系统看到问题的各个方面之前,它一直可以收回相互竞争的证据。 这些属性激发了我们的核心假设:当证据被本地化早期但被选择较晚时,多链推理会得到改善. 实验通过改变单位代表,分解策略,以及每跳保留考生人数来测试这一说法的两面.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • an entity-structured index that localizes composable, typed evidence while preserving exact source provenance; • a hop-wise reasoning buffer that retrieves focused candidate sets and delays hard evidence selection until the complete question can be considered; and • evaluation on HolisQA and two general-domain QA benchmarks, with ablations showing when decomposition, evidence diversity, and retrieval budget matter.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:一个实体结构指数,将可编译的、打字的证据本地化,同时保留确切的来源;一个随机推理缓冲器,可以检索有重点的一组候选人,并将硬证据选择推迟到整个问题得到考虑;以及评价HolisQA和两个一般领域QA基准,在分解时显示证据多样性和检索预算事项。

blocks.en: an entity-structured index that localizes composable, typed evidence while preserving exact source provenance;
blocks.zh: 一种实体结构指数,将可编译的、打字的证据本地化,同时保留确切的来源;

blocks.en: a hop-wise reasoning buffer that retrieves focused candidate sets and delays hard evidence selection until the complete question can be considered; and
blocks.zh: a. 跳动推理缓冲器,可检索重点突出的一组候选人,并延迟硬证据选择,直至整个问题得到考虑;

blocks.en: evaluation on HolisQA and two general-domain QA benchmarks, with ablations showing when decomposition, evidence diversity, and retrieval budget matter.
blocks.zh: 关于Holis的评价 质量保证和两个一般领域质量保证基准,分解时显示分解、证据多样性和检索预算事项。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: RAG combines parametric generation with external retrieval ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) , and dense passage retrieval provides a strong semantic interface for open-domain QA ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) . Work on Dense X Retrieval, LongRAG, and RAPTOR shows that retrieval granularity and hierarchy materially affect what evidence reaches the model ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Sarthi et al., 2024 ) . These methods improve access to long corpora, but a retrieved passage collection still asks the generator to discover which part serves which reasoning step. Resin instead starts from explicit information needs and gives each one a small, source-grounded evidence set.
blocks.zh: RAG结合了参数生成和外部检索(Lewis等,2020年),密集的通道检索为开放域QA提供了强大的语义界面(Karpukhin等,2020年). 关于Dense X Retrival、LongRAG和RAPTOR的研究表明,取回颗粒性和分级对模型中的证据有实质性影响(Chen等,2024;Jiang等,2024;Sarthi等,2024)。 这些方法改进了对长子公司的访问,但是一个检索到的通道收藏仍然要求生成器发现哪一部分服务于哪个推理步骤. 反之,还原是从明确的信息需求开始的,给每个人一个基于源头的小型证据集。

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought and ReAct make intermediate decisions visible ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2023 ) . IRCoT alternates retrieval with reasoning, FLARE retrieves during generation, and Self-RAG learns when to retrieve and critique ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Asai et al., 2024 ) . Their central insight—reasoning should guide evidence access—also motivates Resin . Our distinction is representational: planned hops search a typed index, and all retrieved alternatives remain in a bounded buffer for final reconciliation instead of being reduced immediately to a single intermediate statement.
blocks.zh: 思维链和ReAct使中间决定明显可见(Wei等,2022;姚等,2023.). IRCoT的替代检索有推理,FLARE世代检索,Self-RAG学习何时检索和批评(Trivedi等,2023;Jiang等,2023;Asai等,2024)。 他们的核心见解——理性应指导证据的获取——也激励着Resin。 我们的区别在于代表性:计划跳出搜索一个打入的索引,所有取回的替代品都留在一个定界缓冲器中进行最后调节,而不是立即被降为单一的中间语句.

blocks.en: GraphRAG, HippoRAG2, StructRAG, and LightRAG organize entities and relations to support global, associative, or structure-aware retrieval ( Edge et al., 2024 ; Jiménez Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . SARG searches explicit relational chains ( Parekh et al., 2025 ) , while CausalRAG2 builds hierarchical causal graphs and applies top-down pruning for HolisQA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Such structure is valuable, but a selected path can conflate indexing with reasoning: an extraction or pruning error may remove evidence before the answer is composed. Entity structure has also proved useful in other settings: EnSI-RAG uses it to connect properties and relations to source passages ( Meng et al., 2026b ) , EnSIMem uses it to organize verifiable long-term agent memories ( Meng et al., 2026a ) , and open-schema discovery extracts entity–attribute–value structure without a fixed ontology ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . These applications illustrate the general utility of entities as stable access keys, but address different tasks. Resin targets multi-chain reasoning by using typed structure as an address into evidence and retaining a small buffer of source-linked alternatives, rather than treating the structure as an irrevocable answer path.
blocks.zh: GraphRAG, HippoRAG2, StructRAG, 和光 RAG组织实体和关系以支持全球、联合或结构意识检索(Edge等,2024;Jiménez Gutiérrez等,2025;Li等,2025;Guo等,2025)。 SAG搜索明确的关系链(Parekh等,2025年),而CausalRAG2构建了等级因果图,并对HolisQA适用自上而下推法(Wang等,2026年). 这种结构很有价值,但所选择的路径可以将索引与推理相混淆:在解答组成之前,取出或推倒错误可能会去除证据. 事实证明,实体结构在其他环境中也有用: ENSI-RAG利用它将属性和关系连接到源道上(Meng等,2026b),ENSIMem利用它组织可核查的长期剂记忆(Meng等,2026a),开放-schema发现提取的实体-属性-价值结构没有固定的本体学(Xu等,2026). 这些应用程序说明了实体作为稳定访问密钥的一般用途,但涉及不同的任务. Resin针对多链推理,将打入的结构作为证据的地址,并保留一个源相链接的替代物的小缓冲,而不是将该结构视为不可撤销的答案路径.

blocks.en: 3 RESIN
blocks.zh: 3个

blocks.en: 3.1 Design Goal and Running Example
blocks.zh: 3.1 设计目标和运行示例

blocks.en: Given corpus D D and question q q , Resin uses entity structure to find the relevant original text , then reasons directly over that text. Offline, it builds searchable, source-linked records. Online, it plans focused searches, retrieves records for each need, recovers their source passages, and composes an answer from a small selected evidence buffer (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: Resin使用实体结构寻找相关的原始文本,然后直接在该文本上说明理由。 离线时,它会构建可搜索,源链接的记录. 在线上,它计划有重点地搜索,检索每个需要的记录,取回他们的出处通道,并从一个小的选定证据缓冲器(图1)中编出一个答案.

blocks.en: Consider an illustrative commute: Should I take the bus or metro to reach work within 40 minutes and spend at most $10? Suppose route descriptions list the bus at $4, with a 10-minute walk and a 35-minute ride; the metro costs $8, with a 5-minute walk and a 25-minute ride. Assuming no waiting, the bus takes 45 minutes and the metro 30. Only the metro satisfies both constraints. Answering requires separate evidence chains for the two routes, keeping fares and travel times attached to the correct option.
blocks.zh: 考虑说明性通勤: 我应该坐公交车还是地铁40分钟内到达工作 最多花费10美元吗? 假设路线描述列出公交车票价为4美元,步行10分钟并搭乘35分钟;地铁票价为8美元,步行5分钟并搭乘25分钟. 假设没有等待,公交车需要45分钟和地铁30号线. 只有地铁满足了这两种限制。 回答需要为这两条路线分别提供证据链,将票价和出行时间附在正确的选项上.

blocks.en: 3.2 Design Rationale
blocks.zh: 3.2 设计理由

blocks.en: The planner asks separately for the bus’s fare and journey times and for the metro’s corresponding values. Each need gets its own candidate set, so many matches about one route cannot consume the entire retrieval budget. The hops identify what must be found; they do not decide which route to recommend.
blocks.zh: 规划者分别询问公交车的票价和出行时间以及地铁的相应价值. 每个需要都得到自己的候选人设定,因此许多关于一条路线的匹配无法消耗整个检索预算. 跳跃者确定必须找到什么;他们不决定推荐哪条路线.

blocks.en: A record binds a value to its entity, property, and qualifiers: the bus ride takes 35 minutes , not simply 35 . This distinguishes ride time from total journey time and bus facts from metro facts. Its source pointer recovers the wording needed to check those distinctions.
blocks.zh: 记录对实体、财产和限定值有约束力:公交车需要35分钟,而不仅仅是35分钟。 这区别了乘车时间与总出行时间,巴士事实与地铁事实. 其来源指示器恢复了检查这些区别所需的措辞。

blocks.en: The final composer receives the original question and selected source passages, not generated hop answers. It calculates each journey’s total time and checks both constraints together. An early conclusion such as “the bus is cheaper” therefore need not determine the recommendation before arrival time is considered.
blocks.zh: 最终作曲家接收了原题和所选取的源段落,而不是生成hop答案. 它计算每趟旅程的总时间,同时检查这两个制约因素。 因此,在考虑到达时间之前,“公共汽车价格更低廉”等早期结论不必确定该建议。

blocks.en: 3.3 Source-Linked Evidence Organization
blocks.zh: 3.3 来源关联证据组织

blocks.en: Offline processing groups contiguous sentences around an entity and evidence role, preserves their text and sentence IDs, and extracts minimal evidence-backed units. The bus’s ride-time statement becomes a searchable record linked to its route passage; unrelated service announcements need not enter that record. The record is an access handle, while the original passage remains the evidence.
blocks.zh: 离线处理组围绕一个实体和证据角色相接的句子,保留其文字和句子ID,并取出最低限度的证据后置单元. 公交车的乘车时间声明成为与其路线通过相连的可搜索记录;无关的服务公告无需输入该记录. 记录是一个访问手柄,而原始通道仍然是证据.

blocks.en: Table 1 groups fields by function: claim identity, composition constraints, qualifiers, and provenance. Optional fields require source support.
blocks.zh: 表1按功能分类:索赔身份、组成限制、限定词和出处。 可选字段需要源支持.

blocks.en: Table 1: Functional schema of a reasoning unit. Optional fields are populated only when supported by the source.
blocks.zh: 表1:推理单位的功能计划. 可选字段仅在来源支持时才被居住.

blocks.en: Table 2 distinguishes six kinds of support. A route’s fare is an entity fact; a source-stated effect of congestion on ride time is a directed transition. Rules retain their conditions, and generic type properties remain separate from entity membership. Only source-supported fields are extracted: journey totals are computed at answer time, not inserted as facts during indexing.
blocks.zh: 表2区分了六种支持. 线路票价是实体事实; 拥堵对乘车时间的源头效应是定向过渡. 规则保留其条件,一般类型的属性仍与实体成员资格分开。 只取出源支持的字段:行程总数在回答时间计算,在索引编制过程中不作为事实插入.

blocks.en: Table 2: Reasoning-unit kinds and canonical representations. Colors mark entity, type, property, value, relation, state, and condition slots.
blocks.zh: 表2:合理单位类型和犬科说明. 颜色标记实体、类型、属性、价值、关系、状态和条件槽。

blocks.en: The fields guide the LLM, not a symbolic proof checker: they distinguish evidence roles and expose direction, binding, and qualification for inspection.
blocks.zh: 这些领域指导LLM,而不是象征性的校验:它们区分了证据作用并暴露了检查的方向、约束和资格。

blocks.en: 3.4 The Index as an Evidence Address
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 索引作为证据地址

blocks.en: 4.1 Research Questions
blocks.zh: 4.1 研究问题

blocks.en: We ask: (1) Does entity-structured reasoning improve evidence coverage and answer relevance? (2) Does the approach transfer beyond HolisQA? (3) Which parts of the evidence buffer matter? and (4) What costs accompany its more explicit reasoning process?
blocks.zh: 我们问:(1) 实体结构推理是否改进了证据覆盖面并回答了相关性? (2) 该方法是否转移到HolisQA之外? (3) 证据缓冲事项的哪一部分?和(4) 更明确的推理程序需要多少费用?

blocks.en: 4.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate on the full HolisQA release ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , 500 queries from MS MARCO ( Bajaj et al., 2016 ) , and 426 queries from QASC ( Khot et al., 2020 ) . Together, the benchmarks cover scientific synthesis, web-search QA, and two-fact science composition. Appendix A.1 gives full benchmark details.
blocks.zh: 我们评价HolisQA全文(Wang等,2026年),MS MARCO的500个查询(Bajaj等,2016年),QASC的426个查询(Khot等,2020年). 共同的基准包括科学合成,网络搜索QA,和双事实科学组成. 附录A.1提供了全部基准细节。

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines, Metrics, and Setup
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线、计量和设置

blocks.en: We compare with the published CausalRAG2 suite ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Baseline accuracy and efficiency entries are transcribed from that paper; only Resin is measured in our environment. Appendix A.2 describes the baselines. On HolisQA, we report answer-overlap F1 alongside RAGAS answer relevancy (AR) and context recall (CR) ( Es et al., 2024 ) . F1 measures token overlap with the reference answer; AR measures whether an answer addresses the question, whereas CR asks whether retrieved passages cover claims in the reference answer. Appendix A.4 defines AR and CR. All scores are percentages; overall HolisQA AR and CR are query-weighted means across domains.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了出版的CausalRAG2套房(Wang等,2026年). 从该文件中转录基准准确性和效率条目;只有Resin在我们环境中进行测量。 附录A.2说明了基线。 关于HolisQA,我们报告答案重叠的F1与RAGAS答案的相关性(AR)和背景回顾(CR)(Es等人,2024年)。 F1措施与参考答复重叠;AR措施,一项答复是否涉及这一问题,而CR则询问检索的段落是否涵盖参考答复中的索赔。 附录A.4定义了AR和CR. 所有分数都是百分比;整体HolisQA AR和CR是跨域的查询加权手段.

blocks.en: Our runs use RAGAS 0.4.3 with strictness 3, source-passage contexts, and Gemini-3.5-Flash-Lite as judge. GPT-5-nano performs passage construction, unit extraction, planning, hop solving, and composition; all-MiniLM-L6-v2 performs dense retrieval. The main setting allows at most four hops and retrieves k = 10 k=10 units per hop.
blocks.zh: 我们的运行使用RAGAS0.4.3 严格性3,源通环境,双子座3.5-Flash-Lite作为裁判. GPT-5-nano执行通道构造、单元提取、规划、跳解和组成;All-MiniLM-L6-v2进行密集取回。 主设置最多允许4个跳并取回k=10克=10个单元每跳.

blocks.en: Full-scale CausalRAG2 indexing did not finish within a practical window in our environment. A Biology testing run was completed to verify pipeline execution, not full-dataset performance. We therefore retain published baseline rows. The scores obtained in this test closely match those reported in the CausalRAG2 paper, providing support for the comparability of our evaluation results.
blocks.zh: 全面CausalRAG2指数化没有在我们环境中的一个实际窗口内完成. 完成了一项生物学测试,以核实管道执行情况,而不是完整的数据集性能。 因此,我们保留已公布的基线线。 在这项测试中获得的分数与CausalRAG2文件中所报告的分数非常相近,为我们的评价结果的可比性提供了支持。

blocks.en: 4.4 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.4 主要结果

blocks.en: Resin exceeds the transcribed baselines in reported CR and AR across all five HolisQA domains and in F1 across four domains (Table 3 ). Business F1 is 49.61, below CausalRAG2’s 51.51; Table 4 reports general-domain CR and AR. CausalRAG2 leads the baseline suite across all five HolisQA domains, making it the main reference for our architectural comparison. We therefore focus the following analysis on what Resin adds beyond hierarchical causal retrieval. Evaluator differences and different general-domain query sets remain relevant when interpreting the reported score gaps.
blocks.zh: 在所有5个HolisQA域中,resin超过所报告的CR和AR中转录的基线,在F1中则超过4个域(表3)。 商业F1为49.61,低于CausalRAG2的51.51;表4报告通用域名CR和AR. CausalRAG2领导了所有五个HolisQA域的基线套房,成为我们建筑比较的主要参考. 因此,我们重点分析Resin在等级因果关系检索之外增加的内容。 在解释所报告的分数差距时,评价者差异和不同的一般域查询集仍然相关。

blocks.en: CausalRAG2 uses hierarchical gates and causal refinement to recover coherent explanations. However, multi-chain questions can also require attributes, experimental observations, and comparative properties that do not form another step in the dominant causal chain. An evidence selection centered on that chain may retain a plausible explanation while omitting support for another requested component. Resin makes these heterogeneous claims independently addressable through complementary unit kinds, so their retrieval does not require membership in one connected explanation.
blocks.zh: CausalRAG2使用分级门和因果改进来恢复连贯的解释. 然而,多链问题也可能需要属性,实验观测,以及比较属性,这些属性并不构成主导因子链的又一步骤. 以这一链条为中心的证据选择可能保留一种可信的解释,同时省去对所请求的另一部分的支持。 Resin使这些不同的索赔可以通过互补的单位类型独立解决,因此其检索不需要参加一个相关解释。

blocks.en: A single question-level ranking can allocate much of its evidence budget to the most salient component. Several highly relevant items may then repeat the same mechanism instead of covering different parts of the answer. Resin decomposes the question into focused needs and assigns each its own candidate set. This organization gives less prominent components a retrieval opportunity and reduces competition between different evidence roles. The CR drop when decomposition is removed, together with the losses from single-kind retrieval, supports the value of decomposed access and complementary representations.
blocks.zh: 单一的问题级别排名可以将其大部分证据预算分配给最突出的部分. 几个高度相关的项目可能会重复同样的机制,而不是涵盖答复的不同部分。 resin将问题分解为重点需求,并指定每个自己的候选人组合. 这个组织为不太突出的成分提供了检索机会并减少了不同证据角色之间的竞争. 分解被去除后CR下降,加上单体取回的损失,支持分解访问和互补表示值.

blocks.en: Evidence can also be lost after retrieval: an early selection may discard a claim whose importance becomes apparent only when another component is considered, or final synthesis may fail to use an available distinguishing fact. Resin maps retrieved candidates back to their original passages and gives the final composer the original question and selected source evidence, without the query plan or generated hop answers. The composer can therefore consider explanatory, supporting, and comparative claims together in their original wording rather than inheriting intermediate answer summaries. This changes the reasoning interface from selecting a plausible explanation to assembling support for the question’s distinct requirements.
blocks.zh: 证据也可能在检索后被丢失:早期选择可能放弃只有在考虑另一组成部分时才显出重要性的主张,或者最后综合可能无法使用现有的区分事实。 Resin地图将候选人检索回原段落,并给予最终作曲者原题和所选源证据,没有查询计划或生成hop答案. 因此作曲家可以考虑解释性,支持性,比较性的权利主张合起来,用原来的用词,而不是继承中间答案摘要. 这改变了推理界面,从选择合理解释到收集对问题不同要求的支持。

blocks.en: These differences explain why Resin is particularly useful when an answer depends on heterogeneous, unevenly salient, or interacting evidence. Appendix B provides detailed case studies tracing these failure patterns and the corresponding evidence recovered by Resin .
blocks.zh: 这些差异解释了为什么Resin特别有用,当一个答案依赖于多样,不均匀的突出证据或相互作用的证据时. 附 录 B提供了追踪这些故障模式的详细案例研究以及Resin找到的相应证据。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: Ablations reuse the same HolisQA subset, preprocessing, generator, evaluator, and encoder. Each changes the named component; AR/CR aggregation excludes failed evaluator calls.
blocks.zh: 重复使用相同的HolisQA子集、预处理、生成器、评估器和编码器。 每个更改了命名的组件;AR/CR汇总排除了失败的评价员呼叫.

blocks.en: Figure 2 (b) compares the complete mixed index with six variants that retain only one unit kind. The mixed index obtains 77.0 AR and 89.3 CR. The larger CR loss supports decomposed evidence access, while the smaller AR loss suggests that an answer can remain topical despite missing support. Because the full method also allocates candidates across multiple hops, this experiment does not isolate query specificity from total evidence budget.

blocks.en: 4.6 Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.6 效率

blocks.en: Unit extraction increases offline tokens; planning, hop solving, and composition add online latency. Appendix A.3 gives the cost table, with CausalRAG2 efficiency left as unverified paper-reported values.
blocks.zh: 单位取出会增加下行符;规划,跳解,和组成会增加在线延后. 附录A.3列出成本表,CausalRAG2的效率作为未经核实的报出值。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: Resin is architecturally suited to long contexts because its offline construction processes each passage independently. Moving from a short to a long corpus changes the number of indexed units, but not the amount of text handled by any single construction call. At inference, the complete corpus is never placed in the model context; only the top- k k units for at most H H information needs enter the reasoning buffer. The composer’s context therefore scales with O ⁡ ( H ​ k ) O(Hk) rather than corpus length, allowing the same reasoning procedure to operate over short and long collections.
blocks.zh: resin在建筑上适合长的上下文,因为它的离线构造过程是每个通道独立的. 从短到长都改变了索引单位的数目,但不会改变任何单一构建调用处理的文本数量。 推论,完全体从未被置于模型上下文;只有最多HH信息需要的上-克克单位才进入推理缓冲. 因此,作曲家的背景以O ⁡ (Hk) O (Hk) 来缩放,而不是用体积长度来缩放,使同样的推理程序能够运行在短而长的集合上.

blocks.en: Efficiency is a part that we can study further. Future systems could batch or distill extraction and planning, cache reusable plans and embeddings, update only passages whose source spans change, and choose the hop count and per-hop candidate budget adaptively. These changes would preserve the bounded reasoning buffer while reducing both preprocessing tokens and online latency.
blocks.zh: 效率是我们可以进一步研究的一部分。 未来的系统可以分批或分馏提取和规划,缓存可重复使用的计划和嵌入,仅更新源段变化的段落,并适应性地选择跳动计数和每跳选取的预算. 这些修改将保留有限度的推理缓冲,同时会减少预处理符和在线延迟.

blocks.en: Long-context tolerance at inference does not make complete corpus indexing free. For heterogeneous collections at Wikipedia scale, constructing a fine-grained index over every domain may be unnecessary. A promising extension is query-conditioned coarse indexing : first route a query to a small set of plausible topical shards—for example, technology rather than politics or history—and then construct or activate the entity-structured index only within those shards. When routing is uncertain, cross-domain fallback retrieval can expand the search scope, preventing efficiency gains from making potentially relevant evidence irrecoverable.
blocks.zh: 推论中长文本的容忍性并不能使完整的指数化成为免费的。 对于维基百科规模的多样的集合,构建一个精细的每个域的索引可能是不必要的. 一个很有希望的扩展是查询条件粗糙的索引:首先向一小组可能的热点硬块(例如技术而不是政治或历史)查询,然后只在这些硬块内构建或激活实体结构的索引。 当路由不确定时,跨域回落回取可以扩大搜索范围,使效率收益无法使潜在的相关证据无法被回收.

blocks.en: All datasets used in our experiments were obtained from publicly available benchmark releases and publicly accessible repositories.
blocks.zh: 我们实验中使用的所有数据集都取自公开的基准发布和公开取用的数据库。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented Resin , a multi-chain reasoning framework that uses entity-structured index to find evidence and a compact buffer to reason over it. Focused hop retrieval narrows attention, source links keep every unit auditable, and delayed commitment prevents a locally attractive candidate from prematurely fixing the global answer. Across scientific and general-domain QA, the results and ablations show that this combination improves evidence coverage while making the reasoning process easier to inspect. More broadly, separating evidence addressing from final reasoning provides a practical foundation for extending multi-chain QA to longer and more heterogeneous corpora.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Resin,这是一个多链推理框架,它使用实体结构的指数来寻找证据,并有一个紧凑的缓冲器来解释它。 专注的hop检索缩小了注意力,源链接保持每个单位的可审计性,而延迟的承诺使得当地有吸引力的候选人无法过早地确定全局答案. 在整个科学和一般领域质量保证中,结果和浮出水面表明,这种组合提高了证据的覆盖面,同时使推理过程更容易检查。 更广泛地说,将涉及最后推理的证据与最后推理区分开来,为将多链质量保证扩展到更长和更多样化的公司提供了实际基础。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
A limitation of this study is that we do not empirically evaluate Resin on
long-context multi-chain reasoning. Existing long-context benchmarks primarily
test multi-document question answering or fan-out evidence aggregation ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) ; to our knowledge, they
do not isolate the setting in which multiple distinct evidence chains must be
preserved and reconciled within a single answer. We therefore lack an
appropriate benchmark for directly validating the advantage under long-context multi-chain conditions. Our MS MARCO and QASC evaluations are also limited to 500 and 426 queries, respectively, rather than the complete evaluation splits. These subset results may not capture performance across the full range of questions; extending evaluation to the complete splits remains important when time and computational resources permit. In addition, the offline
index is most suitable when one corpus serves many questions: its construction
cost may not be well amortized for small or rapidly changing collections.
Query planning, hop solving, and final composition also require several staged
online calls. Finally, because Resin is evaluated partly on scientific and
medical questions, its outputs should support rather than replace expert
judgment. Source grounding improves auditability but does not eliminate errors
caused by incomplete corpora or mistakes in extraction, planning, and
generation.

blocks.en: A.1 Benchmark Details
blocks.zh: A.1 基准细节

blocks.en: Benchmark Domain and source Question and reasoning focus Evidence setting HolisQA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) Scientific articles spanning biology, business, computer science, medicine, and psychology Open-ended holistic questions whose answers require integrating statements distributed across an article, including entity properties, relations, conditions, and causal processes Gold answers and multiple supporting sentences are linked to the source articles. We evaluate the complete released dataset and report results separately for its five domains. MS MARCO ( Bajaj et al., 2016 ) Anonymized queries sampled from a production web-search system, paired with passages from retrieved web documents Open-ended question answering in which a system must identify useful evidence among noisy, partially relevant search passages and produce a concise response Candidate web passages accompany each query, and human annotators provide reference answers grounded in passages judged to contain sufficient information. QASC ( Khot et al., 2020 ) Grade-school science questions paired with a large corpus of elementary scientific facts Multiple-choice questions are designed so that two complementary facts must be composed, commonly by connecting a concept in the question to the correct answer through an intermediate concept Gold fact pairs expose the two-step evidence chain supporting each answer, allowing context recall to measure whether both complementary pieces of evidence were retrieved.
blocks.zh: 基准领域和源问题与推理焦点 证据确定HolisQA(王等,2026年) 科学文章涉及生物学,商业,计算机科学,医学,心理学 解答需要整合在一篇文章中分发的语句的开放式整体问题,包括实体属性,关系,条件,以及因果过程. Gold解答和多句支持句与出处文章相关. 我们评价已公布的全部数据集,并就其五个领域分别报告结果。 MS MARCO(Bajaj等,2016年) 从一个生产网络搜索系统抽取的匿名查询,与取回的网络文件的段落对接 一个系统必须在吵闹的、部分相关的搜索段落中找出有用的证据,并制作一个简明的答复。 候选人的网页段落与每个查询同时并列,而人文注释员则根据被认为包含充分信息的段落提供参考答案。 QASC(Khot等,2020年) 高年级科学问题与大量基础科学事实相结合 多重选择问题的设计必须使两个互补的事实构成,通常通过中间概念将问题中的概念与正确答案联系起来 黄金事实对揭示了支持每个答案的两步证据链,允许上下文回顾,以衡量是否收回了两个互补的证据。

blocks.en: We present selected cases in which CausalRAG2 omits a required evidence component and Resin recovers it. The comparison examines original source evidence, saved CausalRAG2 prompts, and the latest Resin answers. Each table isolates the missing component and its architectural significance; it does not equate recovering that component with complete correctness of every additional statement.
